area: focus and keys on the board
situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
Put focus on card SL-103, press ArrowDown, then press Tab.
question: Which part has focus after Tab?
answer: The "Select all in Ready" button. The other cards of Backlog are not Tab stops; the board cards have one Tab stop.
